annotations.title: Answer a Lodestar question about household data

description: Answer one open question. value proposes the corrected field as a data-change proposal that an approver or owner must approve before anything is written; confirm: true records that the data is right, and the same check will not ask about the field again. Send exactly one of them. Developer, approver or owner key. Refused when the household changed since the question was asked. Same as POST /api/v1/questions/{id}/answer.
name: answer_question
